## Core skills
Python, JavaScript, C++, SQL, Flask, Node.js, Express.js, REST API design,
React.js, MongoDB, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Docker, OpenAI Whisper, Coqui
XTTS-v2, FFmpeg, OpenAI API, YouTube Data API v3.

## Projects
- **Automated Media Content Pipeline** (/projects/automated-media-content-pipeline)
  A modular Python pipeline that turns raw video into transcribed,
  voice-processed, vertical-format clips, orchestrated by a GitHub Actions
  cron job. Chains OpenAI Whisper (transcription) and Coqui XTTS-v2 (voice
  synthesis) with FFmpeg for assembly. 800+ commits.
- **Voice Synthesis REST API** (/projects/voice-synthesis-rest-api)
  A standalone Flask microservice exposing text-to-speech as a single REST
  endpoint, built on Coqui XTTS-v2.
- **Movie Booking Platform** (/projects/movie-booking-platform)
  A full-stack MERN application (React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB) with
  authentication and booking history.
